newsitem.title: HONG KONG: EX-HK to Europe, US air cargo rate rise, more seen.
newsitem.headline: EX-HK to Europe, US air cargo rate rise, more seen.

text.p: Airlines are planning to increase ex-Hong Kong air cargo rates to both Europe and the U.S. airline sources told Reuters.
Cargo managers of major airlines to European destinations met informally in Hong Kong on June 25 and agreed to raise rates by HK$3 per kg from August 1.
They also plan another HK$3 per kg rise when their winter schedules begin on October 1, the sources said.
Average rates from Hong Kong to major European destinations such as London and Frankfurt are currently reported to be around HK$21-23 per kg.

China Airlines, which was represented at the meeting, said it would also become the first trans-Pacific cargo carrier to raise its ex-Hong Kong rates to the U.S. by approximately HK$2 per kg from July 1 with another rise planned for August 1.
